$description: Rules for how a generator may use token values. rawValueRestrictions keys are category names that must exist in token-catalog.json categories (checked by verify_all.py).

color.rule: Use a catalogue colour path or a semantic role. Do not introduce a hex or rgba value that is not in the catalogue.

fontFamily.rule: Only the head, body and mono stacks. The licensed original typefaces are not included and must not be added.

fontSize.rule: Use a typeStyle (h1, h2, lede, eyebrow) for page-level text; small mono sizes (<=11px) only inside scaled canvases.

fontWeight.rule: Head text is weight 350; other weights only from the catalogue.

radius.rule: Use catalogue radii; 999 for pills, 12% for system/vendor tiles.

elevation.rule: Use catalogue shadows; do not invent new box-shadow values.

spacing.rule: Section padding is the section-pad clamp; do not substitute fixed values.

motion.rule: Use the catalogued springs, easings and durations. framer-motion and motion-dom stay pinned to 12.42.2.

breakpoint.rule: Only 1080, 760 and 720 plus the hover/pointer and reduced-motion queries.

overrides.reason: The PageSpec schema has no per-instance style or token-override field (styling is owned by the section and component contracts), so there is nothing to validate or mutate at the PageSpec layer. Drift is checked at the catalogue/policy layer by verify_all.py (category names resolve against catalogue keys; catalogue is recomputed from the token files).
